track.title: Homayun: Daramad I
track.notes: Open: the suite's finalis is unsettled: votes split between G and the 4th above it, and Daramad I votes the 4th. Vote kept.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on F#3 and dwells most on F# in Daramad I. The line peaks at A#3 (233.6 Hz) at 0:51.8. It closes on F#3, not the tonic (Gs3 → F#3 → A#3 → F#3 → Ds3 → F#3).
